digo_source: ICRAF Useful Trees ('Digo: Mukungu'); Mgombato ('mkungu ... Indian almond'); Pakia 2005 ('Mkungu')
english: Indian almond, bastard almond, tropical almond

teaser.en: Its giant leaves wrap food, its nuts taste of almond, and before falling the leaves turn a flaming red.
teaser.sw: Majani yake makubwa mno hufungia chakula, kokwa zake zina ladha ya lozi, na kabla ya kupukutika majani hugeuka mekundu kama moto.
teaser.dg: Makodzage makulu sana nkufungira vyakurya, vitsavye vina ladha ya *almond*, na kabla ya kugbwa makodza ganakala ga kundu dza moho.

summary.en: *Mukungu*, the Indian almond, is a tiered shade tree of beaches, village squares and Diani roadsides. Its kernels are eaten, its huge leaves wrap food, and its red wood builds boats.
summary.sw: *Mukungu*, au mkungu, ni mti wa kivuli wenye matawi ya ngazi-ngazi unaopatikana fukweni, viwanjani vya vijiji na kando ya barabara za Diani. Kokwa zake huliwa, majani yake makubwa mno hufungia chakula, na mbao zake nyekundu hujengea vyombo vya bahari.
summary.dg: *Mukungu* (*Indian almond* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wa pepho wenye panda za ngazi-ngazi, unaophahikana kanda-kanda ya ufuwo, kahi-kahi ya vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya njira za Diani. Vitsavye nkuriwa, makodzage makulu sana nkufungira vyakurya, na mbaoze za kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga madau.

about.en:
*Mukungu* grows its branches in flat, horizontal tiers, one above the other like the floors of a pagoda, which makes a wide, layered canopy of shade. Its leaves are huge and broad, wider at the tip than at the base. Before they fall, they turn brilliant red and orange, one of the few touches of autumn colour on the coast.

The fruit is almond-shaped, green and then yellow or reddish as it ripens, with a fibrous husk around a hard shell. Inside is a small kernel that tastes like almond. The fruits float and spread from beach to beach on the sea.
about.sw:
*Mukungu* huotesha matawi yake katika ngazi bapa za mlalo, moja juu ya nyingine kama ghorofa za pagoda, na hivyo kuunda dari pana la kivuli lenye tabaka. Majani yake ni makubwa mno na mapana, mapana zaidi kwenye ncha kuliko kwenye kikonyo. Kabla ya kupukutika hugeuka mekundu na machungwa angavu, mojawapo ya dalili chache za rangi za msimu wa kupukutika majani pwani.

Tunda lina umbo la lozi, la kijani kisha la manjano au jekundu linapoiva, lenye ganda la nyuzi linalozunguka kifuu kigumu. Ndani kuna kokwa dogo lenye ladha ya lozi. Matunda haya huelea na kusambaa kutoka ufuo mmoja hadi mwingine kupitia bahari.
about.dg:
Panda za *mukungu* zinamera sambamba na tsi, ngazi-ngazi, mwenga dzulu ya yanjina dza ghorofa za *pagoda*, na zinahenda pepho pana ya ngazi-ngazi. Makodzage ni makulu sana na mapana, mapana zaidi kpwenye ntsa kuriko kpwenye mlita. Kabla ya kugbwa ganakala ga kundu kali na ga rangi ya chungbwa; ni mwenga wa mihi michache ya pwani inayoonyesa rangi dza za mihi ya tsi za mnyevu wakati wa *autumn*.

Tunda rina umbo ra *almond*, ra chijani, chisha richiivwa rinakala ra rangi ya mandano au ra kundu chidide, na rina gada ra kondze ra nyuzi-nyuzi kuzunguluka gada ra ndani gumu. Ndani kuna chitsa chidide chenye ladha dza ya *almond*. Matunda ganaelea, na ganaenea kula ufuwo mwenga hadi wanjina kpwa bahari.

where.en: It is planted and naturalised along beaches, in village squares and along the roadsides of Diani. Its tiered shape and red leaves make it easy to spot almost anywhere near the shore.
where.sw: Hupandwa na umejiotea kando ya fukwe, katika viwanja vya vijiji na kando ya barabara za Diani. Umbo lake la ngazi-ngazi na majani yake mekundu hurahisisha kuuona karibu popote karibu na ufuo.
where.dg: Ukaphandwa, na sambi unamera wenye kanda-kanda ya ufuwo, kahi-kahi ya vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya njira za Diani. Umbore ra ngazi-ngazi na makodzage ga kundu ganahenda ukale rahisi kuuona phephi phosi na bahari.

uses.en:
The kernel is eaten raw or roasted and has an almond taste. Cracking the hard shell takes patience, and children often do it with a stone.

The large leaves are used as food wrappers, as the Mgombato dictionary notes. The tree is planted for shade, and its red timber is used for boats. Bark, leaves and fruit husks give tannin and dye, and the tree helps to stabilise dunes.
uses.sw:
Kokwa huliwa mbichi au likiwa limechomwa, na lina ladha ya lozi. Kuvunja kifuu kigumu kunahitaji subira, na mara nyingi watoto hukivunja kwa jiwe.

Majani makubwa hutumika kufungia chakula, kama kamusi ya Mgombato inavyoeleza. Mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli, na mbao zake nyekundu hutumika kwa vyombo vya bahari. Gome, majani na maganda ya matunda hutoa tanini na rangi, na mti husaidia kuimarisha matuta ya mchanga.
uses.dg:
Chitsa nkuriwa bila kujitwa au nkuochwa, na china ladha ya *almond*. Kuvundza gada gumu kunahitaji subira, na ana mara nyinji nkuhenda hivyo kpwa dziwe.

Makodza makulu nkuhumirwa kufungira vyakurya, dza kamusi ya Mgombato inavyoandika. Muhi nkuphandwa kpwa pepho, na mbaoze za kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga madau. Gopha, makodza na magada ga matunda vinalavya tanini na rangi, na muhi unaterya kugbwira vidzango vya mtsanga.

culture.en: According to Pakia, the name refers to the pleasant aroma (*kungu*) of the fruit. The tree also lends its name to the beach gardenia, *mkungu wa pwani*, 'the *mkungu* of the seaside'.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linarejelea harufu nzuri (*kungu*) ya tunda. Mti huu pia umeazimisha jina lake kwa *mkungu wa pwani* (*beach gardenia*), yaani '*mkungu* wa pwani'.
culture.dg: Dza Pakia anavyogomba, dzina rinaonyesa arufu nono (*kungu*) ya tunda. Muhi uhu piya ukapha *beach gardenia* dzinare, *mkungu wa pwani*, '*mkungu* wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook writes the Digo name as *mukungu*; the Mgombato dictionary and Pakia write *mkungu*, which is also the Swahili and Giriama name. In English it is the Indian almond, bastard almond or tropical almond, and its scientific name is *Terminalia catappa*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinaandika jina la Kidigo kama *mukungu*; kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia wanaandika *mkungu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Indian almond*, *bastard almond* au *tropical almond*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Terminalia catappa*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mukungu*; Mgombato na Pakia anaandika *mkungu*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Indian almond*, *bastard almond* au *tropical almond*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Terminalia catappa*.

reason.en: Named after it: 'the mkungu of the seaside'
reason.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana nao: 'mkungu wa pwani'
reason.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula kpwa muhi uhu: '*mkungu* wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'

reason.en: Another seaside shade tree used for boat timber
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa kivuli wa pwani unaotumika kwa mbao za vyombo
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pepho wa kanda-kanda ya bahari unaohumirwa kudzenga madau
